correctness.rationale: Spatially constant functions form an exact invariant subspace under Neumann diffusion, and the restricted PDE is the source ODE, so diffusion coefficients cannot alter the side of the homogeneous Hopf branch. At sigma=1 and a0=4, symbolic normal-form reconstruction gives crossing speed 1/16 and first Lyapunov coefficient -5 sqrt(2). The exact H1 witness d1=10, d2=1/5 gives r1=2 and D1=-12/5, proving transverse instability without reversing branch direction.

value.rationale: The article presents the direction and stability of the PDE Hopf bifurcation as a principal extension beyond earlier work. The correction separates two mathematically different conclusions: diffusion can destabilize the homogeneous cycle transversely, but it cannot move that invariant cycle branch from the supercritical side to the subcritical side. The exact H1 witness shows the distinction occurs in the paper’s own parameter regime.
